items.classification: failed-web salvage / source-locator bundle, not a repair package
items.scope: Noether Papers 37 and 42. Extracts source-relevant material from a failed web-thinking transcript and bundles prior RA08 P37 and RA10 P40-P43 packages as provenance/source candidates.
safe_findings: P37 and P42 remain open for full source audit and are not certified closed.
The package points to RA08 for P37: a six-page P37 source scan plus German/English/Spanish/Japanese candidate segment files.
The package points to RA10 for P42: an eleven-page source witness, a German P41/P42 candidate segment, and a German supplement/apparatus layer.
The failed run observed that active/current P42 may be compressed relative to the source and needs page-by-page rebuild/audit.
items.caveat: The web run crashed before producing a finished repair; RA08/RA10 TeX is candidate/locator material only; OCR snippets and transcript excerpts are locator evidence only; the known P42 scan is below the preferred 650+ PPI strict source-certification floor.

items.public_handling: Use README, salvaged_items.csv, and do_not_promote_as_patch.csv first. Treat transcript excerpts as pointers to likely trouble areas only. Any cumulative German TeX patch must be visually source-verified before promotion.
